description: This script automates the building of interface components during the software setup process, primarily by invoking cmake with various target parameters related to AIDL interfaces (e.g., audiodecoder, videosink, deviceinfo, etc.). It includes licensing information, sets up paths, and conditionally defines the version to use.

methods.name: build_interfaces.sh
methods.description: Main entry point of the script that sets up environment, defines paths, and runs multiple cmake commands to build various AIDL interface components.
